head_height.value: 25-30 mm (50-60% of photo space per ICAO guidelines)

file_spec.value: 413 x 591 pixels at 300 DPI, 100 KB - 1 MB (for MyOnline Passport)

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, eyes open, mouth closed, look directly at camera

glasses_policy.value: Contact lenses and spectacles/eyeglasses are NOT permitted during photo capture

ears_visibility.value: Ears should be visible/exposed; long hair must be tied with ears exposed

face_visibility.value: Full face clearly visible; hair must not cover the face; forehead must not be covered (including for hijab wearers)

headwear_policy.value: No hats or headwear; religious hijab permitted but forehead must remain visible and hijab must be dark-coloured (black preferred)

size.evidence: Official IMI page (https://www.imi.gov.my/index.php/en/main-services/passport/malaysian-international-passport/) specifies '35mm x 50mm' with white background. The KLN (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) PDF specification document also confirms 35mm x 50mm. Multiple independent sources corroborate this as the ICAO-compliant standard Malaysia adopted for e-Passports in 2010. This matches the claimed 3.5 x 5.0 cm (35 x 50 mm).
